sources.quote: Create one spec file per capability listed in the proposal's Capabilities section.

items.note: Final-state check that every listed capability has its delta spec file (schema-033 checks the end of ff).

sources.quote: Stop when every capability the proposal lists has its file.

items.downgrade_reason: Only newly introduced segments must be kebab-case; existing capability paths are exempt, and the engine cannot tell the two apart.

sources.quote: use the exact path from the proposal at `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md`. Any path segment newly introduced in the proposal must be kebab-case.

items.note: Moving or renaming a capability during ff would mean writing under the main specs tree. Main specs are only written in archive.

sources.quote: use the exact existing path from `openspec/specs/<capability-path>/` ... Do not move or rename the capability.

items.downgrade_reason: The statement covers files left over from an interrupted earlier run, plus an exception when the user asks; treating it as no-rewrite within ff is an inference.

sources.quote: Do not rewrite an existing file unless the user asks you to.

items.downgrade_reason: The skip_specs: true exception in .openspec.yaml cannot be expressed as a predicate, so the check is applied without it.

sources.quote: There must be at least one spec file unless the change's `.openspec.yaml` sets `skip_specs: true`
If the proposal lists no capabilities and `skip_specs` is not set, revisit the proposal first.
Delta operations (use ## headers): - **ADDED Requirements**: New capabilities - **MODIFIED Requirements**: ... - **REMOVED Requirements**: ... - **RENAMED Requirements**

items.note: Checking this means comparing the new spec path depth with the depth of the existing main specs at BASE_SHA. No kind does that.

sources.quote: Follow the project's existing organization; do not add a new domain level when the project uses a flat layout.

items.note: Needs a selector that maps the modified capability's delta dir to an existing main-spec dir at BASE_SHA. None is available.

sources.quote: Modified capabilities: use the exact existing path from `openspec/specs/<capability-path>/` when creating the delta at `specs/<capability-path>/spec.md`.

items.note: No kind checks for separate, sequential per-file writes, as opposed to one batched multi-file write.

sources.quote: Write the spec files one at a time, so the user sees progress and an interrupted run keeps the files it already wrote

items.note: Checking this means comparing a MODIFIED requirement block with the full original requirement in the main spec. The available rule names cannot express that.

sources.quote: **MODIFIED Requirements**: Changed behavior - MUST include full updated content

items.note: This only applies when a REMOVED Requirements section exists, and no predicate tests whether a section exists. Unconditional label checks would wrongly fail changes that remove nothing.

sources.quote: **REMOVED Requirements**: Deprecated features - MUST include **Reason** and **Migration**

unitemized.reason: Covered by the openspec.capabilities listed_have_specs items for schema-033 and schema-046, which check that each capability listed in the proposal has a spec at specs/<capability-path>/spec.md. A separate item would duplicate that check.
This only applies to modified capabilities, and no available predicate can tell whether the proposal modifies an existing capability. Rule 7: leave it unitemized.

The resume procedure (compare listed capabilities with the spec files already there, then start with the first missing one) depends on state left by an earlier interrupted run and on the agent's internal comparison. It can't be expressed as an observable predicate or event order.
